description: This Java class file defines a workbook populator for importing client entities into a system via Excel spreadsheets. It sets up the spreadsheet layout, data validation rules, and lookup tables to facilitate bulk client data entry and import functionality.

classes.name: ClientEntityWorkbookPopulator
classes.description: A class responsible for populating an Excel workbook with sheets, lookup data, formatting, and validation rules for bulk importing client entities into the system.

methods.name: populate
methods.description: Main method to generate the client sheet in the Excel workbook, set layout, data lookup tables, formatting, and validation rules.

methods.name: setFormatStyle
methods.description: Applies date formatting style to specific date columns in the worksheet.

methods.name: setFormatActivationAndSubmittedDate
methods.description: Helper method to apply the date cell style to a specified date column in a row.

methods.name: setClientDataLookupTable
methods.description: Populates lookup tables with client types, classifications, constitution, main business lines, address types, state/provinces, and countries.

methods.name: setLayout
methods.description: Creates header rows and sets column widths and header labels for the client entity sheet.

methods.name: setRules
methods.description: Defines data validation rules for various columns, including drop-down lists and date constraints, to ensure data integrity.

methods.name: setNames
methods.description: Creates named ranges in the workbook for lookup data and staff lists to be used in data validation.
